Zero radius, square corners: the radius of every component. `rounded-none` is a static class that reads no token; only the Sonner toast reads this one.
Minimal rounding (0.4× base). The legend and tooltip indicators of a chart.
Small rounding (0.6× base). For content a screen draws itself; no component uses it.
Medium rounding (0.8× base). For content a screen draws itself; no component uses it.
Base rounding (1× = 0.625rem). For content a screen draws itself, and the shadcn --radius alias; no component reads it.
Larger rounding (1.4× base). For content a screen draws itself; no component uses it.
Extra-large rounding (1.8× base). For content a screen draws itself (a hero); no component uses it.
Very large rounding (2.2× base). Use sparingly for decorative content; no component uses it.
Maximum rounding (2.6× base). Use only for hero content; no component uses it.

Maximum elevation for toasts and high-priority overlays. Use sparingly.
Inner shadow for pressed, inset, or sunken element states. Not for raised elements.

spacing_rules: **Two axes, two vocabularies** — the steps of the spacing scale (`gap-2`, `px-2.5`, `p-4`) inside and between components; `space.layout.*` (`px-page`, `gap-section`) for the overall layout. Never swap them.
**No arbitrary values** — use the steps of the scale only. When an in-between value is needed, discuss it with the design team first.

**Keep the component's rhythm** — a form lets `FieldGroup` space its fields (`gap-5`), and a card spaces its content with `--card-spacing` (`space.scale.4`, `space.scale.3` at `size="sm"`). Keep to those steps throughout the same component.
**`page-padding` is applied once** — on the page's root container, not on each section.
**`content-*` through `max-width`** — these tokens set maximum widths, not padding. Always pair them with `mx-auto` to center.
radius_rules: **Always use the tokens** — no arbitrary values such as `rounded-[7px]`. When no token fits, escalate to the design team.
**Consistency across the interface** — every system surface is square, so a surface a screen draws next to them stays square. A rounded one among them is the mixed look the system does not have.
**A component draws its own corners** — add no `rounded-*` class to a `Button`, `Input`, `Card`, `Dialog` or any other component.
**`rounded-full` only for a round shape** — an avatar, a dot. Do not use it on a button, a badge or a card.

**The `radius.sm` to `radius.4xl` scale is for content** — an image, an illustration, a hero. `rounded-none` and `rounded-full` are static Tailwind classes that read no radius token, which is why `radius.full` is `reserved`.
elevation_rules: **Follow the hierarchy** — elevation must reflect the surface's real position on the Z axis. A popover never has less elevation than an inline card.
**Always test in dark mode** — light-mode shadows vanish in dark mode unless adjusted. The tokens handle this automatically.
**Elevation transitions** — use `transition-shadow` with `duration-normal` (200ms) on state changes (hover, focus).
**`shadow-inner` stands alone** — never pair it with an outer shadow on the same element.
**No decorative shadows** — elevation expresses structure, not style. Do not add `shadow-lg` to a card just to make it look nice.
